title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 2 Clause 73 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 2 Clause 73 - Stock “Stock” means in the ordinary course of business— (a) anything produced or manufactured; (b) anything extracted or purchased for the purpose of manufacturing, sale or exchange; or (c) all such materials or supplies used in the manufacturing or manufacturing process, But it shall not include shares or stocks; Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
